sources.officialityEvidence: Panama's live official Embassy consular page expressly names Guinea in its authorized-visa cohort and requires in-person consular filing and approval before travel.

policies.title: Guinean ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly includes Guinea in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring consular filing and approval before travel unless a separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Guinean passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Authorized-visa applicants must appear in person at the consulate; approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on verification and document completion.
steps: Determine that the separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Appear in person at the competent Panamanian consulate with the required authorized-visa documents.
Do not finalize travel arrangements until the authorized visa has been granted.
